name: sinonimia
description: Sinonimia — a plain-language dictionary of bureaucratic, legal, and health terms. Static HTML/CSS/JS, no build step.
// note: Sinonimia has no runtime dependencies. wrangler is a devDependency so `npm ci` in CI installs exactly this version (the runner's default `npm install wrangler` resolves to 4.86.0, which can't talk to the modern Pages API). The version pin is what makes the deploy reproducible.
